message: Astra: CREDIT: With “Okay, let’s do that,” have you now moved from planning into a written exchange? Within Ya na’s investigation, what does this exchange establish, and what remains uncertain about the data they will inspect? Would more thought about her fear earn its time over trying their next interaction now; conversely, what uncertainty could make that attempt premature? What detail on the page would discriminate? Can you briefly name your finding and chosen next intention, then carry it out?
